command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create group inventory-readers =="
sudo -n addgroup inventory-readers 2>&1 || true
echo "== create system user inventorysvc =="
sudo -n adduser -S -D -H -s /sbin/nologin -G inventory-readers inventorysvc 2>&1 || true

echo "== ownership: inventorysvc:inventory-readers, recursive =="
sudo -n chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory

echo "== permissions: dirs 750 (rwx r-x ---), files 640 (rw- r-- ---) =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type d -exec chmod 750 {} \;
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 640 {} \;

echo "== VERIFY =="
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers
find /srv/inventory -exec ls -ld {} \;
echo "== data preserved =="
cat /srv/inventory/data/records.csv 2>&1 | sudo -n -u inventorysvc cat /srv/inventory/data/records.csv 2>&1 || true
